```{r functions, include=FALSE}
plot_var_importance <- function(RF, save_name){
  
clrs <- data.frame(n = colnames(dat_test %>%
                          dplyr::select(!goal_YN))) %>% 
  mutate(clrss = scales::hue_pal()(n()))
  
df <- data.frame(RF$importance %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(MeanDecreaseAccuracy, MeanDecreaseGini),
                 n = rownames(RF$importance) )
df <- left_join(x=df, y=clrs, by=join_by(n))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(n = recode(n, "goal_distance"="Distanza dalla porta",
                    "shot_angle_degree"="Angolo di tiro",
                   "play_pattern"="Azione precedente",
                   "shot_type"="Contesto del tiro",
                   "shot_body_part"="Parte del corpo",
                   "shot_technique"="Tecnica di tiro",
                   "home"="Casa",
                   "shot_first_time"="Tiro di prima",
                   "under_pressure"="Sotto pressione"))

df <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseAccuracy)) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n, levels = n)) # Set factor levels based on the order of 'vi'

ggplot(df) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = MeanDecreaseAccuracy, x = n, fill = n), stat = "identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Variabile", y = "Importanza in termini di Accuracy", fill = "Nome della variabile") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = df$clrss, labels = df$n)
ggsave(filename=paste0("../Figures/RF/RF_", save_name, "_accuracy.pdf"), width=165.1, height=114.3, units="mm")

df <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini)) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n, levels = n)) # Set factor levels based on the order of 'vi'

ggplot(df) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = MeanDecreaseGini, x = n, fill = n), stat = "identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Variabile", y = "Importanza in termini di indice di Gini", fill = "Nome della variabile") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = df$clrss, labels = df$n)
ggsave(filename=paste0("../Figures/RF/RF_", save_name, "_Gini.pdf"), width=165.1, height=114.3, units="mm")
}

cm_and_fscore <- function(probs){
  library(yardstick)
  library(pROC)
  my_roc <- roc(dat_test$goal_YN, probs)
  auc <- pROC::auc(my_roc)
  cat("AUC:", auc, "\n\n")
  threshold <- coords(my_roc, "best", ret = "threshold",
         best.method="closest.topleft", best.weights=c(1,mean(dat_test$goal_YN==1))) %>% as.numeric()
  
  cat("Soglia:", threshold, "\n\n")
  
  cat("\n-------------------------")
  Fitted_goal <-  ifelse(probs >= threshold, 1, 0)
  
  f_score <- tibble(t=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
       e=factor(Fitted_goal, levels=c(0,1))) %>% f_meas(truth=t,
                  estimate=e, event_level = "second") %>% dplyr::select(.estimate) %>% as.numeric()
  cat("f-score:", f_score, "\n\n")
  
  caret::confusionMatrix(data=as.factor(Fitted_goal), reference=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN))
}
```

# Dati undersampled

```{r undersampled}
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_undersampled.Rdata")
glimpse(dat_undersampled)
table(dat_undersampled$goal_YN)

tRF <- tuneRF(x=dat_undersampled %>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN),
       y=dat_undersampled %>% pull(goal_YN),
       ntreeTry=ntree_tune,
       mtryStart =4, stepFactor=1.5, improve=0,
       trace=TRUE, plot=TRUE, doBest=FALSE)

df <- tRF %>% as.data.frame()
df
m <- df %>% pull(OOBError) %>% which.min()

source("my_randomForest.R")
Us <- my_RF(dat_undersampled, df$mtry[m], ntree)
cm_and_fscore(Us$rf$test$votes[,"1"])
plot_var_importance(Us$rf, "unders")

save(Us, tRF, file="../RF_pred/RF_undersampling.Rdata")
rm(Us)
```
